cursed.abilityText: When you gain a Cursed card, gain a Loot and a Curse.

fated.abilityText: When shuffling, you may look through the cards and reveal Fated cards to put them on the top or bottom.

fawning.abilityText: When you gain a Province, gain a Fawning card.

friendly.abilityText: At the start of your Clean-up phase, you may discard a Friendly card to gain a Friendly card.

hasty.abilityText: When you gain a Hasty card, set it aside, and play it at the start of your next turn.

inherited.abilityText: Setup: You start the game with an Inherited card in place of a starting card you choose.

inspiring.abilityText: After playing an Inspiring card on your turn, you may play an Action from your hand that you don't have a copy of in play.

nearby.abilityText: When you gain a Nearby card, +1 Buy.

patient.abilityText: At the start of your Clean-up phase, you may set aside Patient cards from your hand to play them at the start of your next turn.

pious.abilityText: When you gain a Pious card, you may trash a card from your hand.

reckless.abilityText: Follow the instructions of played Reckless cards twice. When discarding one from play, return it to its pile.

rich.abilityText: When you gain a Rich card, gain a Silver.

shy.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may discard one Shy card for +2 Cards.

tireless.abilityText: When you discard a Tireless card from play, set it aside, and put it onto your deck at end of turn.
